en:
It's war, you lot!
Bring me my weapon!

War, is it...
When will it ever end...

I march out!
My lord, behold my deeds!

A battle, eh? Ha ha ha!
I can hardly wait!

Looks like it's begun.
Right, here I come!
Naoyuki, lord of Koi Castle, rides out!
I'm Murakami Takeyoshi, chief of the Murakami Navy, finest in the West!
On the honor of the Kurushima Navy...
The Mouri clan has the Kurushima Navy! Come near, and you're fish food!
With this beauty from the Nanban lands, nobody can touch me.

Rrright, we march!
I'll blow them to smithereens!
The swordsmanship I honed for revenge now serves the Mouri clan!
I'll teach you to fear the pirates of Buzen.
Now's the time to march! This gun will riddle them with holes.
note: [edit: mixed idiom 'riddle them full of holes']

en: Well now, I wonder who will win this battle.

Time I rode out, I think.
Bring me my spear!

Here we go, it's battle!
Time to raise some hell!
The song of my flute shall lead us to victory.
Tanezane, head of the Akizuki, noble house of Tsukushi, rides out!
Did you call for me?
Heh heh, I'm itching to fight. I'll show you my secret sword.
Don't take me lightly just 'cause I'm a woman. I'll show you kunoichi arts!
Another battle...
A battle's startin', it is, it is. Guess I'll give it a go, I will!

War again...?
O Buddha, forgive me...
Battle! Time for me to shine!
Don't you fret about rations. Leave 'em to Chosuke here!
Is this the end of the Mouri clan...? Forgive me, everyone...

In a place like this...
I've set my brothers a poor example...
How can I face Lord Motonari now...
You dare make Motoharu retreat?! Someday I'll pay you back for this!
note: Officer #3 = Kikkawa Motoharu. [edit: verbless fragment; 'pay you back for this one day' could misread; Motoharu's hot-blooded voice]

en: Ngh! Am I not fit to take Father's place?!

To outwit me...
Well played...
Careless of me! Forgive me, my lord.
I won't die in a place like this! Fall back! Fall back!
Withdraw at once!
Ngh, before I could even use the tactics Father taught me...
Argh, we're pulling back!
Now that it's come to this, retreat is unavoidable.

Just when it was all beginning...
Forgive me, Father.
Blast! I was too eager for glory!
Father, forgive your unworthy son.

Whoa, this is no good!
Retreat!
I was careless! I never thought they'd be this good...
Tch, not bad! It won't go like this next time!
I must strive harder...
So this is it... I blundered! No mercy next time!

We're no match for them.
Fall back!

How could this happen...
I underestimated the enemy.
Blast! I must retreat! Ninja art! Art of Vanishing in Dust!

How bitter...
I've no choice but to pull back...
To have to fall back here... Curses!
At this rate, we're beaten. I must flee before my retreat is cut off.
Is this all my swordsmanship is worth...? No! Next time, for sure...
Tch, the tide's against us. Guess I've got no choice but to retreat.
I never knew they were this strong... At this rate, we're finished...
Pathetic, losing like this. Sorry... Forgive me, will ya...
Careless, careless.
Our losses are worse than I expected... I'd best pull back for now.
Well, well, I've gone and lost.
Hmmm... No choice, then.

Retreat? Surely not...
This wasn't supposed to happen...
The West's mightiest pirate, falling back?! Curse you!
On the honor of the Kurushima Navy... Next battle, I swear...

Time to pull back.
Gotta live to fight again.

Nothing for it.
I'll withdraw for now.
Even this cannon can't turn the tide of battle...?
My skills aren't honed enough... I must start my training over.
note: [edit: 'training ... training' repeated; 'honed' echoes his sortie I0334]

en: Dammit all! I've gone and shamed the pirate name.
Did I get too close to the enemy?! I have no choice but to retreat!

Blast, are we surrounded?
Retreat at once!
Not yet, I can't die yet... I have no choice but to fall back.
So I'm still too green... I want more strength...
Does my flute's song not reach them...?
Is this the end of my ambition?
Blast, at this rate... Argh! Ninja art! Art of the Heavenly Five Escapes!
Argh, I underestimated the enemy! Next time, no mercy.
Eek! I can't take any more!
You'll pay for this!
Ow, ow, I'm done for... Sorry, but I'm pullin' out.
